subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 1: revises Term 1 sounds; /i/ (it, sit, pit, tip); differentiates p and i; segments oral sentences into words

show.line: Listen. i, i, it. i, i, sit! Sit has the i sound.

rounds.prompt: Which word has the i sound? Sit, sat.
Say the sound with me. i, as in it!
Listen. p, i, t. What word is it?
Is it p or i? Listen. It.
Listen. t, i, p. What word is it?

hints: Smile a little and say i. i, i, it.
Say each sound, then say them fast.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Listen. s, i, t.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! s, i, t makes sit.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's do it together. s, i, t. Sit!

parent_line: Can hear the i sound and blend words like sit, pit and tip.
